cli_command.note: 所有 CLI 与配置命令统一写 openclaw。

positioning.zh: ClawBot 是一个面向 Feishu 和 CLI 的本地智能体网关方案。
positioning.en: ClawBot is a local agent gateway designed for Feishu and CLI workflows.

positioning.zh: 当前仓库主要保存架构说明、部署步骤和后续优化草案。
positioning.en: The current repository mainly stores architecture notes, deployment steps, and follow-up optimization drafts.

architecture.zh: ClawBot Gateway 位于 Feishu 或 CLI 与底层模型、工具、Skill 之间，负责接入渠道、模型路由与能力编排。
architecture.en: ClawBot Gateway sits between Feishu or CLI clients and the underlying models, tools, and skills, handling channel access, model routing, and capability orchestration.

architecture.zh: 默认模型路由示例包括 primary: qwen-portal、code: ollama/qwen2.5-coder、fallback: ollama/qwen2.5。
architecture.en: The default model router example includes primary: qwen-portal, code: ollama/qwen2.5-coder, and fallback: ollama/qwen2.5.

architecture.zh: 核心工具可包括 shell、filesystem、web/http、search/docs；Skill 层可包括 openclaw-ops、deploy-helper、feishu-helper、log-troubleshooter。
architecture.en: Core tools can include shell, filesystem, web/http, and search/docs; the skills layer can include openclaw-ops, deploy-helper, feishu-helper, and log-troubleshooter.

setup_installation.zh: PowerShell 安装命令可写为：iwr -useb https://molt.bot/install.ps1 | iex
setup_installation.en: The PowerShell installation command can be documented as: iwr -useb https://molt.bot/install.ps1 | iex

setup_installation.zh: 若安装脚本报错，可在当前会话临时放开脚本执行权限：Set-ExecutionPolicy -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Scope Process。
setup_installation.en: If the install script fails, you can temporarily relax PowerShell execution policy for the current session: Set-ExecutionPolicy -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Scope Process.

setup_installation.zh: Git 可通过 winget install --id Git.Git -e --source winget 安装。
setup_installation.en: Git can be installed with winget install --id Git.Git -e --source winget.

feishu_integration.en: Candidate Feishu permissions include im:message, im:message.p2p_msg, im:message.group_at_msg, im:message.group_msg, and im:chat.

feishu_integration.zh: Feishu 插件安装命令可写为：openclaw plugins install @miheng-clawd/feishu。
feishu_integration.en: The Feishu plugin install command can be documented as: openclaw plugins install @miheng-clawd/feishu.

feishu_integration.zh: 飞书凭证配置命令候选：openclaw config set channels.feishu.appid "<YOUR_APP_ID>" 与 openclaw config set channels.feishu.appSecret "<YOUR_APP_SECRET>"。
feishu_integration.en: Candidate Feishu credential commands: openclaw config set channels.feishu.appid "<YOUR_APP_ID>" and openclaw config set channels.feishu.appSecret "<YOUR_APP_SECRET>".

feishu_integration.zh: 私聊授权可通过 openclaw pairing approve feishu <PAIRING_CODE> 完成。
feishu_integration.en: Private chat authorization can be completed with openclaw pairing approve feishu <PAIRING_CODE>.

gateway_operations.zh: Gateway 运维命令候选：openclaw gateway restart 与 openclaw gateway status。
gateway_operations.en: Candidate gateway operations commands: openclaw gateway restart and openclaw gateway status.

gateway_operations.zh: 当网关未正常拉起时，可切换到本地模式：openclaw config set gateway.mode "local"。
gateway_operations.en: If the gateway does not start normally, you can switch it to local mode with openclaw config set gateway.mode "local".

cloudflare_tunnel.zh: 推荐链路是本地 Feishu webhook 先监听 127.0.0.1:3000，再通过 Cloudflare Tunnel 暴露到公网 HTTPS 地址供飞书事件订阅使用。
cloudflare_tunnel.en: The recommended path is to serve the local Feishu webhook on 127.0.0.1:3000 first, then expose it through Cloudflare Tunnel as a public HTTPS endpoint for Feishu event subscriptions.

cloudflare_tunnel.zh: Cloudflare Tunnel 常用命令候选：cloudflared tunnel login、cloudflared tunnel create openclaw、cloudflared tunnel route dns openclaw <YOUR_DOMAIN>、cloudflared tunnel run openclaw。
cloudflare_tunnel.en: Candidate Cloudflare Tunnel commands: cloudflared tunnel login, cloudflared tunnel create openclaw, cloudflared tunnel route dns openclaw <YOUR_DOMAIN>, and cloudflared tunnel run openclaw.

model_routing.zh: Agent 路由示例可以写成：defaults 使用 openrouter/anthropic/claude-3.7-sonnet，coder 使用 openrouter/openai/gpt-4o-mini，research 使用 openrouter/anthropic/claude-3.7-sonnet。
model_routing.en: An agent routing example can document defaults on openrouter/anthropic/claude-3.7-sonnet, coder on openrouter/openai/gpt-4o-mini, and research on openrouter/anthropic/claude-3.7-sonnet.

model_routing.zh: 在聊天渠道中可通过 @coder 与 @research 这样的 agent 名称切换不同模型策略。
model_routing.en: In chat channels, agent names such as @coder and @research can be used to switch model strategies.

token_optimization.zh: 成本来源可拆成系统提示、工作区文件、对话历史、工具输出和当轮问题五部分。
token_optimization.en: The cost breakdown can be split into five parts: system prompt, workspace files, conversation history, tool output, and the current-turn query.

token_optimization.zh: QMD 按需知识注入适合作为文档站中“上下文优化”或“知识检索”章节的候选内容：通过本地索引与向量检索，只向模型注入命中的相关片段。
token_optimization.en: QMD on-demand knowledge injection is a strong candidate for context optimization or knowledge retrieval sections: it uses local indexing and vector search to inject only the relevant matched snippets into the model.

token_optimization.zh: 本地小模型跑心跳可作为“自动化成本控制”章节候选内容：把低复杂度的定时检查交给本地模型，只在需要时再升级到更强模型。
token_optimization.en: Running heartbeat tasks on a local small model is a good candidate for automation cost-control sections: handle low-complexity periodic checks locally and escalate only when needed.

operator_workflow.zh: Windows 长期运维工作流的候选内容可采用 WSL + tmux + Codex CLI 组合，并共享 CODEX_HOME。
operator_workflow.en: A strong candidate for the long-term Windows operator workflow is the WSL + tmux + Codex CLI setup with a shared CODEX_HOME.

operator_workflow.zh: 日常工作布局候选：pane 1 跑 codex，pane 2 跑测试，pane 3 跑服务或查看日志。
operator_workflow.en: Candidate daily layout: pane 1 for codex, pane 2 for tests, and pane 3 for services or logs.
